dispositions.strongest_counterargument: The direction is binding policy and readable off the catalog: ruling 3 makes a state that certifies 'plain, thin, or builder-grade' presence non-billable, both candidates remove that state, both dry-run clean, both are positive-only house-style states with name and description overrides, and candidate A is written in ruling 4's own vocabulary with every disjunct tied to datedness by construction.
dispositions.resolution: Not sustained as drafted. (1) The live check blocks both wordings under the rule as written; the decisive card is rc_9e889631af67, where the harness reproduces production and both wordings still bill plain white trim (A 1/3, B 2/3). (2) The datedness tie is a parsing property, not a guard: Terra never engaged either predicate in twelve calls. (3) B's over-reach is measured in a stronger form than Steven's concern: it billed on a dark wall colour in a room with white trim, and B's second disjunct near-duplicates paint_refresh_recommended's claim ('interior paint color | dated or highly personalized colors'), an item with the same rooms and package role, so one colour scheme could be accepted twice into one bucket. (4) The only claimed benefit, recovering rc_b642fe69b86a, is uninformative because the control arm recovers it with the current wording; and photo_028 of that card already carries a baseboard_wear_scuffs condition in the same estimate unit, so the datedness addition is also a double-billing route. (5) The redraft's non-wording content survives challenge and is carried: the withdrawal of the structural-exception claim (bar_met_by 'none'; the change is a ruling-3 application), the package-emit correction verified in code (rehab_packages.py:2221/2225/2233, 1056-1091), the citation corrections, confidence 'low', and the completed ten-card ledger with rc_ceeb17f8e242 resting on Q-3 and the label note (the pinned photo review records a plain baseboard present in photo_025, disclosed) and rc_57c6faf79c7e disclosed as a FOURTH human-approved billing the op would withdraw with no ruling covering it.
dispositions.required_modification: No wording is proposed for approval. Options for Steven, none of which is in the tested candidate set: (a) close CAP-008 as not eligible and record that a state rewrite alone was not shown to change what Terra bills on these cards, with ruling 3 standing as policy; (b) a removal-only state (drop the plain/thin/builder-grade branch with the name and description overrides, no new billable tell) under a fresh live-check authorization; (c) an instrument outside this program's ops surface (a require_any/deny_any guard, a route-level change, or a Terra prompt rule for literal reading). A third datedness wording is not recommended: two lexically disjoint wordings behaved identically and the remaining ceiling cannot fund a full arm.
dispositions.residual_risk: If nothing changes, dated_interior_trim keeps billing plain presence on the reviewed cards (two hallucinations and four human-approved billings, one unruled), which ruling 3 says is not billable. Any future CAP-008 op must rule on rc_57c6faf79c7e, treat rc_73d15ca14405 as an ambiguous control, and expect every stored Terra checkpoint to be invalidated (CCF-8).

dispositions.resolution: Sustained with conditions. The blinds successor does what ruling 5 as extended by Q-1 requires and could not be broken: no wear or damage word on any rendered surface, route_override valid on all four validator checks and deterministic ahead of the no-economics check, and no blinds-only bullet in the corpus reaches the billable successor ('Window treatments are dated and basic.', the leak the Session 3 review flagged, now reaches only the no_action item). The withdrawn-billings accounting reproduces exactly across three derivations (48 conditions, 39 accepted, 28 moving to no_action, 10 surviving, 1 reaching neither). The fabric successor is sustained in part: the refuters' finding that 'shower curtain' matches only the contiguous phrase is correct (term_matches is leading word-boundary containment), and the lead applied the narrowing fix ('shower', 'tub' added to its deny_any) and re-tested it against the corpus bullets: the three bathroom hardware bullets are now denied, blinds-only and fabric positive-control bullets are unchanged. That fix post-dates the refuters and was mechanically re-verified, not adversarially re-reviewed; it is disclosed for approval. The drafter's ledger denied a gold unit that exists (gold g3 matched to the accepted billing oc1_12e3660bf3923583 in the bundle's matching rows) and built an open question on that denial; the lead corrected the row and withdrew the question, so Q-1's stakes stand as put. Two mechanism statements were corrected to exact-kind retrieval without changing any outcome.
